workflow.name: Generate an auto-updating SVG stats badge on GitHub from your creator profile
workflow.description:
Showcase your n8n creator profile with a dynamically generated SVG stats badge, automatically pushed to any GitHub repository on a schedule — ready to embed in your README in seconds.

What this workflow does
On a configurable schedule, this workflow fetches your public creator profile from the n8n community, builds a fully styled SVG card displaying your name, avatar, total workflows, and community username, then pushes it directly to a GitHub repository. If the file already exists it updates it; if not, it creates it automatically. The final node outputs both the raw GitHub URL and a CDN-cached URL for embedding.
What you'll see in your README
A clean, animated 495×190px badge showing:

Your avatar (circular, pulled live from your n8n profile)
Display name and "n8n Creator" label
Total workflow count
Approved workflow count
Community username
Direct link to your n8n creator page

Setup

Open the ⚙️ Config node and fill in your n8n community username, GitHub username, target repository, and your preferred card colors
Add your GitHub credentials to both GitHub nodes
Adjust the Schedule Trigger to your preferred refresh interval (daily recommended)
Activate — the badge will be created on first run and kept up to date automatically

Embed in your README
![n8n Stats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YOUR_GH/YOUR_REPO/main/n8n-stats.svg)
Nodes used: Schedule Trigger, Set, HTTP Request, Code, Extract From File, GitHub, Aggregate

parameters.content:
## 📊 n8n Creator Stats Card
**Automatically generates and pushes an SVG profile badge to GitHub, showing your n8n creator stats — perfect for embedding in a GitHub README.**

---

### 👤 Who is this for?
Anyone who publishes templates on n8n.io and wants a live stats badge on their GitHub profile or repository README.

---

### ⚙️ How it works
1. **Schedule Trigger** fires on your chosen interval (default: daily)
2. **Config** — single node where you set all your personal details
3. **Fetch Creator Profile** — pulls your stats from the n8n community API
4. **Parse User** — extracts name, avatar URL, and workflow counts
5. **Download & Encode Avatar** — fetches your avatar image and converts it to Base64
6. **Build SVG** — assembles a styled 495×190px SVG card with your stats
7. **GitHub Push** — edits the existing file, or creates it if it doesn't exist yet
8. **Final URLs** — outputs the raw and CDN-cached URLs to embed

---

### 🚀 Setup (5 steps)
1. Open the **⚙️ Config** node and fill in all 7 fields
2. Add your **GitHub credentials** to both GitHub nodes (Edit & Create)
3. Make sure the target GitHub repository exists and is **public**
4. *(Optional)* Adjust the **Schedule Trigger** interval
5. **Activate** the workflow — it will run automatically going forward

---

### 🖼️ Embed in your README
```
![n8n Stats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YOUR_GH_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/main/n8n-stats.svg)
```

### 🔧 Step 1 — Configure
Edit the **⚙️ Config** node below.
Fill in every field before activating.

### 🌐 Step 2 — Fetch & Parse
Retrieves your public creator profile
from the n8n community API and
extracts name, avatar, and workflow counts.

### 🖼️ Step 3 — Build SVG
Downloads your avatar, encodes it
to Base64, then assembles the
full SVG stats card.

### 📤 Step 4 — Push to GitHub
Tries to **edit** the existing file first.
If the file doesn't exist yet, the error
output routes to **Create** instead.

⚠️ Add GitHub credentials to **both** nodes.
